name: dev_checkout_gateway
description: Stateful checkout service with a genuine supporting payment actor.
resource_constraints_text: Deploy Docker containers on Azure Linux VMs in Korea Central. Keep monthly infrastructure cost below 450 USD. A single availability zone is acceptable.

classified.text: Shoppers create a cart and add, change, or remove catalog items.
Shoppers submit a delivery address and review the final order total before checkout.
During checkout, the system requests payment authorization from the external Payment Gateway.
The system creates an order only after the Payment Gateway approves the authorization.
Shoppers view the current status and item details of their orders.
Support agents cancel an unshipped order and the system requests a refund from the Payment Gateway.
Cart and order records shall survive container and VM restarts.
Concurrent checkout submissions for the same cart shall create at most one order.
Checkout shall support peaks of 60 requests per second.
Payment credentials shall be supplied at runtime and shall not be stored in the image.
The application shall run in Docker containers on Linux VMs and expose health and latency metrics.
